description: This Python script is designed to recursively read and embed header files into source files by replacing #include directives with the contents of the respective headers. It is a utility for processing C/C++ header includes within a project, specifically for embedding headers during build or analysis.

methods.name: list[str] read_file(fname: Path | str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the lines of a file specified by filename.

methods.name: str _embed_headers( content: list[str], include_dirs: list[Path], processed_files: set[str] )
methods.description: Recursively replaces #include directives in content with the actual header file contents.

methods.name: str embed_headers( fname: str, include_dirs: Sequence[str] | Sequence[Path] | str | None = None )
methods.description: Public function to initiate header embedding process, setting include directories if not provided.
